$comment: Elements whose TEXT is expected to differ between web and a device but whose box and style must still match (docs/parity/LAYOUT.md). Keyed by screen id; "*" applies to every screen. selector: CSS selector run on the web DOM (the element and its descendants collapse into one layout element). textRegex: matches the element's own text instead. clock: true = text is scored (not volatile) for a device that declares clockPinned. maskOnly: never scored; its rect is blanked in the pixel scorer. omit: not exported at all.
